title: From the Vault: Revisiting AFI's untouchable emo-punk classic, 'Girl’s Not Grey'

blocks.text: Before pop-punk and emo dominated mainstream stadium tours and became staples of algorithmic nostalgia playlists on streaming platforms, there was a glorious, transitional moment in early 2003 when underground credibility collided head-on with major-label ambition. At the epicenter of that sonic earthquake stood the California-bred quartet AFI (A Fire Inside) and their explosive breakthrough single, “Girl’s Not Grey.” Over two decades after its initial release, revisiting this track feels less like a casual trip down memory lane and more like a masterclass in how a band can evolve without ever surrendering its soul.
